name: Meeting Notes to Actions
summary: Turns meeting notes or a transcript into decisions, action items with owners and dates, and open questions.
description: Reads raw meeting notes or a transcript and extracts what matters afterwards: decisions made, action items with an owner and due date (only if stated), open questions and parked topics, plus a short recap you can paste into Slack or email. Decisions and actions quote the notes, so nothing is recorded as agreed that was only discussed. Who it's for: anyone who runs meetings: managers, project leads, founders, chiefs of staff. Limitations: owners and dates are left as "unassigned" or "no date" when the notes do not state them; it does not create tasks in your tools.
problems: Nobody remembers what we agreed in meetings
Action items from meetings get lost
I need a meeting summary with owners

inputs.label: Notes or transcript
inputs.example: Agreed to move launch to 19 June. Priya to update the help center by Friday. Still unclear who owns the Xero partnership.

outputs.label: Meeting outcomes
outputs.description: Decisions, action items, open questions and a recap.

execution.system: You are a meticulous chief of staff. Record only what the notes show was decided or assigned, quoting the notes. Discussion is not a decision. Leave owners and dates blank rather than guessing.

quote.description: Copied word for word from the notes.

owner.description: Name or role from the notes, or "unassigned".

quote.description: Copied word for word from the notes.

steps.name: Extract outcomes
steps.responsibility: Pull decisions, actions and questions from the notes.
steps.prompt: Extract decisions and action items, copying the supporting words exactly into quote. Use "unassigned" and "no date" when the notes do not state them. Put unresolved points under open_questions. Keep the recap to three sentences.

steps.name: Check outcomes
steps.responsibility: Decisions and actions quote the notes; the recap is short.

criteria.description: Every decision quotes the notes word for word.
Every action item quotes the notes word for word.
The recap is 70 words or fewer.
